comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district sign popups. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected into world space via road.project(). radius is trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review:true = best estimate from map data — the owner's lived knowledge is authoritative over all coordinates and community boundaries.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: Narrow peninsula — calm harbour to the left, rough open sea to the right

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Gateway where the Palisadoes strip meets Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Famous for Rockfort Mineral Bath — natural sulphur spring pools

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Named for the clear Blue Mountain views from the avenue

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Kingston's busiest crossroads — major bus terminus

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's uptown business district — hotels, offices, restaurants

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Named for the great cotton tree that marked the halfway point to the hills

communities.name: Hagley Park
communities.note: West Kingston residential area along Hagley Park Road

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former capital, founded by the Spanish in 1534 — historic square intact

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: St. Catherine hill community — named after Lord Sligo, a governor of Jamaica

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Rio Cobre gorge town — the historic one-lane Flat Bridge is just ahead

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine market town at the north end of the gorge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous for Linstead Market — 'Carry mi ackee go a Linstead Market'

communities.name: Guys Hill
communities.note: Rural St. Catherine community up in the hills

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann crossroads town — the road forks here toward Ochi

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside strip — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival since forever

communities.name: Alexandria
communities.note: St. Ann market town in the interior

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: World-famous canopy road — over 550 species of ferns line the gorge walls

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann resort town — journey's end at Dunn's River Falls
